quests.title: Tea Party Re-Invitation: Lauma

dialogue.t: This is truly delicious herbal tea, Miss Sandrone.

dialogue.sit: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)
I think it's time I started clearing up.

dialogue.t: So soon? How about I treat you to dinner at the Frostmoon Enclave?

quests.description: Go to the Frostmoon Enclave, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Lauma…
